first_step_test: A broad curved scarf loop and two short neck edges give a beginner a simple fixed center for the hanging ends.

source.notes: Contact sheet first; reject inconsistent iterations privately.

final_elements.name: center neck loop
final_elements.description: One soft U-shaped folded scarf loop near the upper center, with an open lower crossing.

final_elements.name: left hanging end
final_elements.description: A wide fabric strip drops down-left from behind the loop, ending in a slanted hem.

final_elements.name: right hanging end
final_elements.description: A second wide strip drops down-right from the loop, ending in a slanted hem at about the same height as the left.

final_elements.name: two hem bands
final_elements.description: A narrow stripe just above each hanging hem.

final_elements.name: six fringe tassels
final_elements.description: Three separate short tassels hang from each hem, six in all.

final_elements.name: fabric folds
final_elements.description: A few curved fold strokes inside the loop and along both hanging ends.

frames.visible_job: Draw a broad U-shaped fold near the upper center with two close edges and leave its lower crossing open.
frames.instruction: Near the upper center, draw a wide curved U for the scarf fold. Echo its inner edge with a shorter curve and leave an open gap below for the two ends.

frames.visible_job: Add a broad strip falling diagonally left from behind the loop to a slanted hem.
frames.instruction: From behind the left side of the loop, pull two gently wavering lines down-left and join them with a slanted hem. Keep the strip wide enough for a narrow band.

frames.visible_job: Add a right strip from the right edge of the loop, ending at about the same height as the left hem.
frames.instruction: Start at the right edge of the loop and draw a second broad strip down-right. Close it with a slanted hem about level with the left hem; keep the two ends separate.

frames.visible_job: Place one band above each hem and exactly three distinct fringe tassels under each.
frames.instruction: Draw a stripe just above each hem. Hang three short separated tassels from the left hem and three from the right, counting six before adding texture.

frames.visible_job: Add a few curved fold lines inside the neck loop and on both hanging ends.
frames.instruction: Inside the loop, add two shallow curved fold marks. Pull one or two light folds down each hanging end, following its fabric direction without changing the outer edges.

final_step.visible_job: Deepen the established folds with soft graphite hatching and a restrained muted red pencil on the two bands.
final_step.instruction: Shade the underside of the loop and the existing folds with light graphite hatching. Add muted red to the two hem bands and a few broken knit strokes inside the established strips; leave white paper for highlights.
adds: graphite and muted red on established forms

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop has only two nested handmade U curves at the upper center, leaving clear white space below for the two hanging ends.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Six saved square crops build one fixed scarf: left end, right end, two bands and six tassels, then interior folds before graphite texture and muted red band color. No temporary guides appear; each earlier keeper contour remains legible.

transitions.observed_addition: The upper loop stays at the same anchor while one wide left strip falls from its left shoulder to a slanted hem.
transitions.instruction_match: The left-strip instruction matches its two descending edges and slanted hem.

transitions.observed_addition: The loop and left strip stay fixed; a separate right strip descends from the right shoulder to a hem at about the same height.
transitions.instruction_match: The right-strip instruction matches the new separate end and its level slanted hem.

transitions.observed_addition: Both strips and the loop remain; each hem gains one narrow band and three separate tassels, six tassels across the sheet.
transitions.instruction_match: The band-and-fringe instruction matches two bands with three tassels on each hem.

transitions.observed_addition: Both bands and all six tassels remain; two shallow curves appear within the loop and light long folds inside both ends.
transitions.instruction_match: The fold instruction matches the added curves without a changed outer edge.

transitions.observed_addition: All six tassels, both bands, both ends and the loop remain as graphite hatching fills the established fabric and muted red fills the bands.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction matches graphite value and muted red in established regions; no new structural contour appears.
